gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of malignant glioma (defined as WHO grade III or IV) with previous RT to tumour

candidate_evidence.quote: There is only one study visit during which study subjects will undergo a 18F-FET PET/CT in SGH.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: With enlarging contrast-enhancing and/or T2W/FLAIR-hyperintense lesion(s) on MRI within the previous RT field

role_evidence.quote: There is only one study visit during which study subjects will undergo a 18F-FET PET/CT in SGH.

source_quote.quote: Gliomas with Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type status, as defined on immunohistochemistry

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study (FET PET); no therapeutic agent. Population is WHO grade III or IV malignant glioma, IDH-wildtype; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels. IDH-wildtype is required, so cns5 coded.
